notes.title: The Clowns are back, 1 year anniversary update is coming soon!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45229827/2b0cbbec9f73ff509f8ef26388086613bfea0ff9.png"]
Get ready to s&@t your pants!

After being live for a year already! We are excited to announce a massive 1 year anniversary update for free! Featuring a whole new gameplay experience!  What's coming? Well look no further, take a peak below and find out! 


A brand new carnival map that's  interactive! 

New mini-games added to the game modes to make it a littler more challenging!

Restore power system to help track down those balloons!

New more advanced clowns that add a whole new fear factor! 

Characters overhaul and movement update! 

New jump scares!

Revive system! 

User Interface update!

Holiday Editions! 

And a secret addition that we won't announce just yet ;) 




Coming October 2025
